novel_features.name: Privacy audit before sharing
novel_features.description: Find content and metadata risks before a PDF leaves your machine.
novel_features.rationale: Correlates local metadata and text signals without uploading the document.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this when an agent must check a document for accidental sensitive content before delivery.

novel_features.name: Integrity trail
novel_features.description: Record SHA-256, SHA-1, and MD5 hashes for inputs and outputs.
novel_features.rationale: A CLI can emit a stable integrity record directly alongside generated artifacts.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this when downstream systems need to verify that a PDF was not changed.

novel_features.name: Agent-native inspection
novel_features.description: Expose PDF structure, metadata, and hashes as compact JSON.
novel_features.rationale: The CLI provides stable machine output without requiring a browser preview or download click.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this before any transformation when an agent needs to understand the artifact.

novel_features.name: Local PDF text search
novel_features.description: Search extracted text across local PDFs and return matching snippets.
novel_features.rationale: Agents need a fast local way to locate relevant phrases without uploading documents or opening a browser preview.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this when an agent needs to locate a phrase across a local document set.

novel_features.name: Local PDF catalog
novel_features.description: Index PDF paths, hashes, page counts, and extracted text in a local SQLite catalog.
novel_features.rationale: A durable local index makes repeated document search and reconciliation fast without inventing a remote API.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Choose this when an agent needs a searchable, repeatable inventory of local PDFs.

narrative.headline: Private PDF operations for agents, scripts, and offline pipelines.
narrative.value_prop: ihatepdf.cv CLI brings the website's no-upload promise to the terminal. Merge, inspect, fingerprint, encrypt, search, catalog, and convert documents locally with JSON output and reproducible artifacts.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the local-only runtime without touching a file.
Inspect page count, metadata, and integrity before processing.
Check for sensitive content and metadata risks.
Record stable hashes for downstream verification.

troubleshoots.symptom: The input is not a readable PDF
troubleshoots.fix: Run `ihatepdf-cv-pp-cli inspect file.pdf --json` and verify the path and file type.

troubleshoots.symptom: A transformation refuses to overwrite a file
troubleshoots.fix: Choose a different `--output` path; the CLI never overwrites inputs by default.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for local, privacy-sensitive PDF preparation, inspection, and repeatable file pipelines. It is especially useful when an agent needs structured JSON and deterministic output paths.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for interactive browser editing, camera capture, P2P sharing, or collaborative whiteboards.
